expected.label: Compensation / CTC
expected.why: You should know exactly what you're paid and when.

expected.label: Notice period
expected.why: Defines how much notice either side must give to end employment.

expected.label: Termination conditions
expected.why: Spells out when and how employment can be ended.

expected.label: Non-compete clause
expected.why: Restricts where you can work after leaving — worth knowing the length and scope.

expected.label: Service bond / penalty
expected.why: Some contracts require you to serve a minimum period or pay a penalty.

expected.label: IP / invention assignment
expected.why: Determines who owns work you create, including outside office hours.

expected.label: Confidentiality (NDA)
expected.why: Defines what you can't share, and for how long, even after leaving.

expected.label: Leave / PTO policy
expected.why: Clarifies how much paid leave you get and what happens to unused leave.

expected.label: Dispute resolution / governing law
expected.why: Determines where and how disagreements are legally resolved.

expected.label: Stock options / equity (ESOP)
expected.why: If discussed verbally, written terms should exist — silence here is a red flag.

expected.label: Rent amount & due date
expected.why: Basic terms of what you owe and when.

expected.label: Security deposit & refund terms
expected.why: Clarifies how much is held and when/how you get it back.

expected.label: Notice period to vacate
expected.why: How much notice either side must give before ending the lease.

expected.label: Lock-in period
expected.why: A minimum period you're obligated to stay, sometimes with penalties for leaving early.

expected.label: Maintenance responsibilities
expected.why: Who pays for repairs, and for what kind of damage.

expected.label: Landlord entry / notice requirement
expected.why: Whether the landlord must notify you before entering.

expected.label: Renewal / auto-renewal terms
expected.why: Whether the lease renews automatically and under what terms.

expected.label: Subletting / guest policy
expected.why: Whether you're allowed to sublet or host long-term guests.

expected.label: Utilities & who pays
expected.why: Clarifies which bills are your responsibility.

expected.label: Definition of confidential information
expected.why: Sets the scope of what's actually protected.

expected.label: Duration of confidentiality obligation
expected.why: How long you're bound after the relationship ends.

expected.label: Mutual vs one-way obligation
expected.why: Whether both sides are bound, or just you.

expected.label: Exceptions (public info, prior knowledge)
expected.why: Standard carve-outs that protect you from unreasonable restriction.

expected.label: Governing law / jurisdiction
expected.why: Determines where any dispute would be handled.

expected.label: Payment terms
expected.why: What's owed, when, and any late fees.

expected.label: Termination conditions
expected.why: How either side can end the agreement.

expected.label: Liability / indemnification
expected.why: Who's responsible if something goes wrong, and whether it's capped.

expected.label: Dispute resolution / governing law
expected.why: Where and how disagreements are resolved.

expected.label: Renewal / auto-renewal terms
expected.why: Whether the agreement renews automatically.
